title: too few options radios not dropdown
name: Too few options: radios, not dropdown — NN/g
rule: Too few options → radios, not dropdown (NN/g “handful” / ~under 5; DS cutoffs cited on-page: USWDS <7, M3 6, Carbon 3).

citation.source: NN/g — Does Your Form Really Need a Dropdown List?

pass_when: A handful of options (~under 5; other cited DS cutoffs on-page) is radios, not a dropdown.
fail_when: Two–few options hidden in a dropdown.
overview: A handful of options (~under 5) should be radios, not a dropdown.
apply_when: Choice sets with roughly under five options (handful / DS cutoffs).
not_when: Two-to-few options hidden inside a dropdown.
agent_hint: Use radios for a handful of options; do not hide few choices in a dropdown.
description: Too few options should be radios, not a dropdown. NN/g points at a handful (~under 5); cited design-system cutoffs on-page include USWDS under 7, M3 at 6, and Carbon at 3. Pass when a handful of options is radios, not a dropdown. Fail when two-to-few options are hidden in a dropdown instead of staying visible as radios.
do_not_claim: One house cutoff that collapses NN/g handful vs USWDS <7 vs M3 6 vs Carbon 3 vs Polar <4. Overlap with Forms 54: `forms.inputs.match_control_and_size`, `dropdown_chooser`, `combo_box`, `offer_choices_not_only_text`.
